jobs.title: Strategic Finance Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT OMNI

Omni is the AI analytics platform that turns company data into a trusted source of truth for AI. Built on a semantic model, Omni gives enterprises a governed context graph for analytics and AI. Teams use Omni to ask questions in plain English, refine answers in workbooks, and bring trusted data into tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Slack.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Omni has raised $217M from the world’s top investors, including ICONIQ, Theory Ventures, First Round Capital, Redpoint Ventures, and GV. Its latest $120M Series C valued the company at $1.5B.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Strategic Finance Manager to own the quantitative core of our finance function. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role: you'll own the company financial model end-to-end, write the playbook for our core FP&A processes, and be the person who goes deep on the numbers behind major decisions.



You'll work directly with senior Finance leadership and functional leaders across the company. This isn't a support role — you'll take ownership of your work, handle novel problems independently, and improve our financial infrastructure as the business scales.



We're growing fast, so the model and the work are always changing. If you want to build and run complex financial systems at a company where your output is visible to leadership and shapes real decisions, this is the role.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Financial Model Own Omni's company financial model end-to-end: maintain the 5-year model, run scenario analyses, and build new components as the business evolves.

 - FP&A Cadence Run the core monthly and quarterly cycle: variance analysis, actuals-vs-budget reporting, and quarterly forecasting across the company. Partner with Accounting to keep financial data flowing cleanly into FP&A models.

 - Budgeting Lead the annual budget process: work with department leaders to build departmental budgets, roll them into a company-wide budget aligned to the financial model, and manage budget governance throughout the year.

 - Commissions Own the commission model and monthly payout calculations; partner with Sales and RevOps leadership to keep it accurate as comp plans change and the sales team grows.

 - Ad Hoc Analysis Run financial analysis to support strategic decisions across the company — pricing, hiring plans, investment cases, and similar one-off requests from leadership.




ABOUT YOU

 - 5-7+ years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, corporate finance, or consulting

 - Advanced Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills; comfortable building financial models from scratch

 - Deep familiarity with SaaS business models and core SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, CAC, LTV, churn)

 - Experience running FP&A workflows: variance analysis, budget vs. actuals, forecasting

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-moving startup where scope evolves

 - Experience at a scaling startup.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Recruiter Screen (30 min) 

 2. HM Interview (45 min) 

 3. VP Finance Interview (45 min) & Cross-Functional Team Interview (30 min) 

 4. Case Study (45 min) 

 5. Founder Interview (30 min)




LOCATION

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based anywhere in the US.




WHY JOIN US

 - Passionate, supportive team with extensive experience in the space (including founders from Looker and Stitch Data) all working together to win as a team

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) Plan (for US-based roles)

 - Unlimited PTO


Omni is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and encourage you to apply even if you don’t check every single box. Please, let us know if you need any reasonable accommodations during the interview process.

jobs.description:
ABOUT OMNI

Omni is the AI analytics platform that turns company data into a trusted source of truth for AI. Built on a semantic model, Omni gives enterprises a governed context graph for analytics and AI. Teams use Omni to ask questions in plain English, refine answers in workbooks, and bring trusted data into tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Slack.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Omni has raised $217M from the world’s top investors, including ICONIQ, Theory Ventures, First Round Capital, Redpoint Ventures, and GV. Its latest $120M Series C valued the company at $1.5B.




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Omni, our Business Development function is a cornerstone of our hypergrowth trajectory. As one of the fastest-growing Series B companies, we've established our BDR organization as a primary driver of qualified pipeline. We pair this exceptional business impact with a strong focus on career development, creating clear advancement paths for BDRs into strategic roles within the company.



As the Manager, BDR North America you'll lead a high-impact team and serve as the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for scaling qualified pipeline across the region. Working in close partnership with our marketing team, you'll drive and optimize revenue-generating initiatives in key markets.



We're looking for a leader to build and mentor a world-class BDR team while accelerating our footprint across North America.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Scale pipeline through strategic top-of-funnel initiatives

 - Coach BDRs to excel in prospecting, pitching, and objection handling

 - Drive rapid pipeline growth through a high-urgency, results-focused culture

 - Build an elite BDR team through strategic hiring and establishing clear career advancement paths

 - Collaborate with marketing and sales to optimize pipeline performance

 - Lead upmarket expansion through focused BDR strategy execution




ABOUT YOU

 - 2+ years in an SDR/BDR Organization with 1+ years in leadership

 - Track record of scaling outbound programs with measurable revenue impact

 - Experience with modern sales tech stack

 - Proven ability to hire, develop, and retain high-performing teams

 - Strong understanding of NAM market dynamics and business practices

 - History of driving results in high-growth environments




LOCATION

This role will be hybrid, 3 days per week in our SF office. 


WHY JOIN US

 - Passionate, supportive team with extensive experience in the space (including founders from Looker and Stitch Data) all working together to win as a team

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) Plan (for US-based roles)

 - Unlimited PTO

jobs.description:

Teams use Omni to ask questions in plain English, refine answers in workbooks, and bring trusted data into tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Slack.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Omni has raised $217M from the world’s top investors, including ICONIQ, Theory Ventures, First Round Capital, Redpoint Ventures, and GV. Its latest $120M Series C valued the company at $1.5B.






ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Regional Sales Director, Enterprise to lead a high-growth team and drive predictable revenue in the segment of customers with 501-5,000 employees.

You will combine elite sales execution with a talent for coaching and scaling operations. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in the data ecosystem and thrives in building collaborative, scalable sales processes.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Revenue Strategy & Execution

 - Own enterprise new business and expansion targets, ensuring accurate forecasting and pipeline health.

 - Execute GTM initiatives and personally support high-impact, strategic deals to ensure closure.

 - Drive disciplined CRM usage and data-driven decision-making to optimize sales performance.

Leadership & Team Growth

 - Lead, recruit, and coach a high-performing team of Account Executives to exceed KPIs.

 - Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and hands-on deal coaching.

 - Set clear performance standards and develop career paths for the commercial sales team.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

 - Partner with Marketing on pipeline generation and Product to share market insights.

 - Collaborate with Customer Success to ensure seamless handoffs and long-term expansion.

 - Refine internal processes to improve efficiency across the commercial segment.
   
   


ABOUT YOU

 - 5+ years of B2B sales experience, including 2+ years leading high-performing enterprise teams.

 - Proven track record of exceeding targets in SaaS. Experience in BI, data analytics and/or ETL platforms strongly preferred

 - High agency and comfort driving results within fast-paced, Series A–D environments



LOCATION

We have physical hubs in SF, Santa Cruz and Denver, so if you’re someone who thrives in an office environment, our doors are open! If you're not in those locations, it's a remote opportunity.




WHY JOIN US

 - Passionate, close-knit team with extensive experience in the space, including founders from Looker and Stitch Data

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) Plan

 - Unlimited PTO
